evidence_class: REGISTRY-MEASUREMENT + OWNER-REPORT (scores are not organizer receipts)
registry_scope: All TIFF blobs outside data/ in nine public focus repos; not other sites/private submissions.

lattice_gate_bound.reasoning: Dots outside the 3 px halo of the lattice can only sit on uncovered cells. At least 30% of a candidate's dots must be outside the halo, so N <= uncovered / 0.30.
